card.name: End of warning section headings
card.fires_on: The last pieces of a warning heading just before the paragraph text starts, mostly 'Perforation' in 'Gastrointestinal Bleeding, Ulceration, and Perforation' in NSAID labels. Also closing a heading term such as '(TIN)'.

modes.label: Perforation heading
modes.description: Pieces of the word Perforation ending the NSAID GI bleeding warning heading.
modes.example: 5.2 Gastrointestinal Bleeding, Ulceration, and Perfor<<ation>> NSAIDs, including flurbiprofen

modes.label: Other heading or list ends
modes.description: The close of a heading abbreviation or a phrase in a risk statement, right before the body text.
modes.example: Acute tubulointerstitial nephritis (TIN<<)>> has been observed in patients taking PPI

card.plain: It fires at the end of a warning section title, just before the explanatory text begins, especially the NSAID bleeding and perforation title.
